name: shared-test-cases
goal: Show recorded test inputs beside observed outputs through the same shared component in every entity test view

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Verified nonfunction artifacts currently use raw blocks; Desktop Evidence shows coverage without behavior. Require one shared case table with exact before/after scope and explicit evidence gaps.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Reports SSR3/DesktopSSR1 missing-case failures; Reports Tests browser4 failures; Desktop Evidence7 missing-table failures with before captures. Fixture/checkpoint errors retained separately; CoveragePanel unchanged for final frozen red.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus shared renderer and Evidence integration implemented. Root preserved aliases, fixed test-only capture plumbing, and bound required screenshots and actual UI observations.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen tests pass: Reports17 browser/21 case units, Desktop31 browser/16 units; readability, scrolled output and raw JSON pass. Declared scenario accepts19 captures with0 failures. Earlier fixture, lint and missing-observer failures retained.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
